description: Shree Vasu Logistics Limited engages in the logistics business in India. The company operates through Logistics, Warehousing and Allied services; and Retail Trade segments. It also offers carrying and forwarding agency, warehouse renting, packaging, transportation and distribution services, and third-party logistics solutions. In addition, the company provides rental and warehousing activities, providing end-to-end integrated supply chain solutions, including transportation, warehousing, real-time tracking, last-mile delivery, allied services, and value-added services. Further, it serves electronics, FMCG, e-commerce, paints, tyres, adhesives, auto parts, automobiles, healthcare, textile, project deliveries, trucking, agriculture, and pesticides industries. Shree Vasu Logistics Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Raipur, India.
